Definition: Sheshak, a symbolic name of Babylon
BiblicalUsage: Sheshak is the secret name of Babylon, spoken by Jeremiah when the cup of wrath passes to the nations and when the city falls. The name is a cipher, and the prophet uses it where the plain name would be too dangerous to speak.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a secret name is a prophet's protection, and Babylon's fall is certain enough to be spoken in code. I hold that the city that calls itself eternal is the one God renames.
